method: Black Hole Superradiance Bayesian Constraint Framework
definition: Use the physics of BH superradiance to define exclusion regions in (M, a*) space for each boson mass, then marginalize over BH posterior distributions to derive probabilistic constraints

key_structural_ingredients.notes: Direct computation from BH mass and boson mass

key_structural_ingredients.ingredient: Critical spin curve a*_crit(α, l, m) = 4mα/(m² + 4α²)
key_structural_ingredients.notes: Derived from superradiance condition ω = mω_+

key_structural_ingredients.ingredient: Superradiance rate Γ_{lmn} from non-relativistic formula
key_structural_ingredients.notes: Using Eq. 18 of Arvanitaki et al. 2011; valid for α/l << 1

key_structural_ingredients.ingredient: Instability timescale comparison with BH age

key_structural_ingredients.notes: Using simplified version of Eq. 48-49 of Arvanitaki et al. 2011
Both l=1 and l=2 modes included in exclusion

deviations: Non-relativistic approximation used throughout (exact numerical solutions not computed)
BH age estimates are order-of-magnitude (not from detailed stellar evolution models)
Self-interaction constraints use simplified energy balance, not full nonlinear evolution
